review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an opinion that economy has more important, whereas others it has negative disadvantage for them. There are strong cases to be made for both side of the argument.

Admittedly, one might argue that advertising brings undeniable economic benefits. This is creative content and appealing visual effects that stimulate consumer demand and therefore spending power and increasing production. Accordingly, people has more employment opportunities and greater state revenues through taxation, leading to a stronger economy. For example, e-commerce platforms, Shopee or Lazada in Vietnam rely heavily on advertising campaigns to attract customers, boosting not only their sales but also the entire digital retail sector. Besides, advertising creates jobs in marketing, media and design, hence making it an important driver of economic activity.

However, some might argue that advertising has negative social consequences. It constantly show images of perfect lifestyles, beauty standards, or luxury possessions, consequently fostering dissatisfaction among viewers. For example, young people, in particular, feels pressured to buy trendy clothes or the latest smart gadgets advertised on TikTok or Facebook, leading to frustration when they cannot afford them, thereby advertising promotes materialistic values and a money-driven culture in the long run.
In conclusion, I strongly believe that both views are valid to some extent advertising which contributes to social dissatisfaction, or plays a crucial role in economic development.

completion.comment: Bài có đủ bốn phần trên ảnh.

review.overall: Em có đủ bốn phần, có ví dụ Shopee/Lazada và phát triển được cả hai hướng của dàn ý. Tuy nhiên, bài còn nhiều lỗi chia động từ, câu ghép và cách mượn lời quá chung. Em cần nghiêm túc viết lại theo bản sửa, nhất là Body 2 và Conclusion, rồi dành thời gian tự soát trước khi nộp.

task.text:
Some people say advertising has positive economic effects. Others think it has negative social effects because it will make people dissatisfied with who they are and what they have.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
